selection.source: Previously exposed8-calves fullframes; frozen actual raw mixed-body detector proposals. No GT boxes/IDs or new video.
selection.rule: Sort actual boxes by(center_x,center_y,original_index); take positions floor(j*(N-1)/3),j0..3. ForN<=4 keep all, explicit missing slots, no backfill.
selection.box_model_class: Mixed Cows2021+early8calves detector class0 represents cow body; rawcheckpoint names stringitem retained as provenance, not biologic label.

native_pose.preprocessing: Use actual pinned author TopdownAffine output, BGR->RGB and savedmean/std. No PCA/prerotation.
native_pose.decode: Pinned author UDPHeatmap and exact add_pred_to_datasample source mapping; all10 channels/points/scores retained.

preinference_review.method: AI visual headward-direction/anatomy review on exact original crops+rawbodybox context, completed before pose outputs. Ambiguous head/tail and mixed/truncated bodies explicit.
preinference_review.not_ground_truth: Not external human landmark annotation or biologicalIDs; prior scene familiarity disclosed.

review_after_inference: All16 fullcontext overlays and raw10landmarks/heatmapscores. Compare fixed prereview heading qualitatively, retain reversed/neighbor/degenerate/outside-body/uncertain cases. No rotations,threshold tuning,filtering,backfill,recognition labels or alternate accuracy score.
source_caveat: CheckpointselfreportsV5Purdue; trainingimage membership not independently audited. Current8calves viewpoint/generalheading/occlusion differs. Exposedscenefeasibility only, not independent fullsystemaccuracy.
